text:
Sam (Events): Heads-up — finalizing registration page copy for next week's webinar. Need APAC-friendly time slots and a clear consent checkbox for recording + repurposing.
Alex (Marketing): Agree. Can we keep a two-option schedule? 9am PST / 9pm AEST. Single sign-up flow with timezone detection.
Priya (Growth): Please add a UTM param template so we can split paid vs organic leads. utm_source=webinar&utm_campaign=launchbench
Diego (Ops): Zoom settings: recording to cloud + auto-transcribe enabled? Remember consent required for recordings. Also we need local captions vendor toggle.
Sam (Events): Yup — cloud recording + transcription. Who owns editing and split clips after?
Maya (Sales Ops): Sales wants registrant + attendee CSV within 10 mins of session end. HubSpot import mapping: email, company, job_title, utm_campaign, attended(true/false), watch_time.
Zuri (Content): We'll need a short post-event asset pack: 3x clips (3m, 1m, 30s), a transcript, and 2 social captions (LinkedIn + X). Can Ops output SRT aligned to clip timestamps?
Diego (Ops): We can output SRTs but need the clip timestamps to be pinned before export. Propose a small manifest:
```
clips: ["intro_3m","snippet_q&a_1m","cta_30s"]
master_recording: cloud://redwood/webinars/2026-03-xx
srt_requested: true
deliver_to: repo/webinar-assets/{{event_id}}
```
Sam (Events): Perfect. Also: opt-in language for reuse — keep copy short: "I consent to being recorded and to receiving follow-up content." Any legal check?
Alex (Marketing): Legal sign-off done last week for the template copy. Use that variable so translations are consistent.
Priya (Growth): For lead routing: attendees -> Sales queue MQL if watch_time >= 10mins OR asked a question. Otherwise go to nurture. Use a Zapier webhook for real-time routing.
Maya (Sales Ops): Zapier mapping agreed but prefer direct HubSpot webhook to avoid Zap rate limits. Provide a fallback Zap only if primary fails.
Diego (Ops): I'll add a routing lambda with idempotency. Endpoint: POST /webhooks/webinar-events with api_key header. Sample payload:
```
{
  "email": "",
  "attended": true,
  "watch_time": 123,
  "utm": {"campaign":"launchbench"}
}
```
Zuri (Content): Can we add a follow-up email template right now? Short + link to replay + clip. Also include 3 CTAs: watch replay, chat with sales, download whitepaper.
Alex (Marketing): Draft copy shared in GDoc: https://docs.google.com/…/webinar-followup-draft — please comment by EOD. We'll A/B test CTA order.
Sam (Events): Timezone/localization checklist: registration page shows local time, reminders 24h and 1h before in attendee timezone, replay open for 72h for APAC registrants.
Priya (Growth): Also append GA4 event on CTA clicks: event_category=webinar, event_label=cta_replay|cta_sales|cta_whitepaper. Add dataLayer push on click.
Diego (Ops): Confirming captions vendor: need vendor account creds by Tuesday. If not, we'll fallback to Zoom auto captions (lower accuracy).
Zuri (Content): Can someone own the caption QC? A 5-min sample review would be enough.
Maya (Sales Ops): Sales readiness: playbook + talk track for top 10 questions. I'll send a short doc and set a 20-min prep call with SDRs.
Sam (Events): Final items — make sure registration confirmation page includes a 'share with colleague' link (pre-filled message) and tracking param so referrals are tagged.
Alex (Marketing): I'll create the social post snippets after we lock the asset pack. Need one short quote from the speaker for the 1m clip caption — @Zuri can you pull?
Zuri (Content): Got it. Will pull a punchy line and add 3 headline variations.
ZoomBot: Recording started (cloud) — meeting id: 987-654-321.
Sam (Events): Thanks everyone. Action items: Diego add webhook & manifest, Maya HubSpot mapping, Zuri asset headlines + caption QC, Alex finalize social snippets, Priya set UTM & GA4 events. I'll update the registration page copy and push live tonight.
Alex (Marketing): One more — can we release an automated post-event nurture over 3 touches: immediate replay, 3-day deep-dive asset, 2-week product follow-up. Sequence ready?
Maya (Sales Ops): Yes — sequence steps + SLA to Sales in doc. I'll schedule the flows after the attendee list is in.
Priya (Growth): I'll run a small paid test in APAC for the evening slot; budget set to $500/day for two days leading up.
Diego (Ops): All infra pieces mapped. Will send the webhook test payload to the channel when ready.
Sam (Events): Excellent. If nobody flags legal or vendor creds by EOD tomorrow, we fallback to Zoom autosub and Zapier fallback. Closing thread after deploy. :rocket:
